summary: ERSS (112 AI auto-dispatch) feature verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_erss_ai_dispatch.py — SOS/accident incidents get a well-formed erss_report (phone=9620910910, email=narendra.macherla@ndvtechsys.com, non-empty ai_narrative, call_status mentions dialing 9620910910, email_body contains rider GPS + Google maps link + EMERGENCY CONTACTS section); deviation incidents correctly get NO erss_report; sos-audio upload flips latest sos incident's erss_report.audio_attached=true, sets audio_id, and email_status now mentions 'audio'; public /api/track/{token} exposes erss.phone=9620910910 and notified=true once SOS exists; POST /api/track/{token}/erss-call returns {phone:'9620910910'} and logs a 'Family member initiated a call to 112 / ERSS' event; invalid token returns 404. Frontend: TrackView renders data-testid='track-erss-card' with 'CALL 9620910910' button (data-testid='track-call-erss-button') and displays the 'AI dispatcher has already auto-reported' note when notified; Dealer Command Center incident detail modal renders data-testid='dealer-erss-report' with call/email/sent-to/audio rows and the AI narrative quote; Live journey SOS panel renders data-testid='sos-erss-report' with call+email status lines and the narrative after triggering SOS (mic recording UI shows 'Recording audio for family' which is expected — the actual mic doesn't run headless but the UI path is fine).

issues: Radix Dialog warning in console: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and missing aria-describedby — accessibility only, non-blocking.

React key collision warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key 9999900000' — duplicate contact phone used as list key in the shared_data.contacts rendering (both dealer detail and live SOS). Cosmetic/logging only.

action_items: (low) Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) + aria-describedby to the dealer incident detail Dialog to remove Radix a11y warnings.
(low) Fix duplicate React key warning for shared_data.contacts list — use contact index or `${name}-${phone}-${idx}` as key instead of raw phone.
critical_code_review_comments: build_erss_report + _generate_ai_dispatch are correctly awaited and fall back to a deterministic narrative on LLM error — good.
raise_incident branches on payload.type — deviation correctly skips erss_report; accident + sos both attach it. Verified.

upload_sos_audio safely updates only the LATEST sos/accident incident's erss_report via sort=[('created_at',-1)]; a stale/earlier report will NOT get the audio if a new SOS happens later — that appears intentional.
server.py is 1022 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting incidents/track routes and the ERSS helpers into their own modules.

public_track exposes erss.notified based on 'any sos/accident incident on the journey' via a $in query; if a journey ever has an erss_report cleared, notified would still be true. Non-issue for current spec.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ERSS_/UI_ERSS_ journeys and incidents under rider usr_test1, plus one contact 'TEST_ERSS_Contact' 9999900000. Safe to prune from db.journeys/db.incidents/db.contacts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_erss_ai_dispatch.py is xdist-safe (uses pytest.mark.xdist_group('erss_seq')). If running without xdist, use `-o addopts=''` to override the project's parallel default. LLM narrative is live — assertions only check non-empty + phone/email presence in status strings, not exact wording. Dealer detail modal's block text is CSS-uppercased so `inner_text()` returns 'AI DISPATCHER'; use case-insensitive matches. LiveJourney needs a long route (>=100 points) to give you time to click SOS before the journey auto-completes.
